purpose: Pre-generated scene artwork for the Sib Marriage & Love event messages (proposal, wedding, divorce, flower gift).

usage.note: Inert provenance record. No runtime code loads this manifest or these files; Marriage/Love handlers are unchanged and currently send text-only messages. The artwork is staged here so it can be attached to the existing event messages without building a new asset system.

generation.tool: arena-agent image model (text-to-image with style reference)

scenes.description_en: Marriage proposal — Red Apple kneeling and offering a golden ring to Golden Apple.
Marriage accepted / wedding — the newlywed couple celebrating together.
Divorce — a humorous, friendly separation of two apple characters.
Flower gift — one spouse offering a bouquet to the other.
